name: Imprint Guard
description: Press a faint mark of soul into the qi guard so that both hold as one.

name: Mark Turn
description: Turn a blow with the marked guard so that body and soul both slip aside.

name: Twofold Feel
description: Feel a strike through the qi of the body and the wisp of the soul together.

name: Twin Mending
description: Mend flesh and soul in the same slow breath with qi that carries the soul's calm.

name: Qi Veil
description: Weave a veil that is half qi and half soul so that blows of either kind slip off.

name: Marked Cleanse
description: Cleanse a taint that lies in body and soul together by passing the marked qi through both.

name: Dual Shell
description: Close a shell of qi over a shell of soul and bear a heavy assault on both.

name: Fused Deflection
description: Turn a combined qi and soul blow aside and return a share of each to the sender.

name: Imprint Sovereign
description: Take in a barrage of qi and soul force through the marked guard and hold it as one store.

name: Soul-Qi Aegis
description: streams: Defense Soul + Qi; fuse both into one aegis that shields mind and body against every kind of force.

name: Weighted Ward
description: Let the ward settle onto the body as a weight that the user can lean upon.

name: Bone Veil
description: Draw the veil down into the bones so that a blow is turned within the frame.

name: Flesh Listen
description: Listen for a soul blow through the weight of the muscles and the skin.

name: Blood Calm
description: Slow the blood with the calm of the ward until the shock of a blow has gone.

name: Frame Bearing
description: Bear a heavy blow upon the whole frame of the body with the ward held in each bone.

name: Marrow Return
description: Return a soul blow up from the marrow in a sharp physical jolt.

name: Body Cleanse
description: Cleanse taint from the flesh and soul of an ally by pressing the ward over both.

name: Body Gift
description: Lend the weight of the ward to an ally's body so that both stand firmer.

name: Presence Shell
description: Make the body itself a solid presence that no soul or blade can easily cross.

name: Embodied Reply
description: Answer a soul strike with a blow of body weight that carries the ward in it.

name: Flesh Sovereign
description: Let the body take a soul assault whole and still it in the weight of the ward.

name: Sovereign Body
description: streams: Defense Soul + Body; fuse both until the ward is a physical presence that nothing of soul or flesh can pass.

name: Intent Guard
description: Raise the guard on bare intent a heartbeat before any blow is thrown.

name: Early Slip
description: Slip aside on the first flicker of a hostile thought so that the strike never lands.

name: Thought Catch
description: Catch the shape of a hostile intent in the qi before it is spoken or moved.

name: Quick Mend
description: Mend a fresh hurt of the soul with qi that moves as soon as the pain begins.

name: Instant Shell
description: Form a full shell on a half formed thought as a blow begins to move.

name: Anchored Pulse
description: Pass an anchored pulse of qi to an ally so that their guard also forms before they think.

name: Prior Ward
description: Set a ward where the blow will fall before the blow is even drawn.

name: Anticipate Break
description: Break up the first motion of a hostile soul attack in the very moment of its forming.

name: Foreknown Sovereign
description: Take in an assault already known by its first intent and read its sender whole.

name: Anchored Intent
description: streams: Defense Soul + Qi; bind both so that a perfect guard stands in place before the thought of danger finishes.
